## Why this activates

This works because users experience immediate, personalized financial value by seeing their own cash flow and actionable insights, rather than spending time learning the product.
The friction I removed was unnecessary setup, onboarding quizzes, manual data entry, and feature tours, reducing the time between sign-up and the Aha moment.
Which matters because it predicts faster time-to-value and higher activation, which we hypothesize will lead to stronger trial-to-paid conversion as users recognise FinWise's ongoing value.
